DELETE FROM EDS.TREASURY_ACCOUNT_HOLDER WHERE AS_OF_DATE = @DateProcessed;

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1
@PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY =FULLDATE
FROM
EDS.DATE_DIM
WHERE
FULLDATE<@DateProcessed
AND Business_Day_Flag='Y'
AND FULLDATE=DATEADD(day,1,Previous_Business_Day)
ORDER BY
FULLDATE DESC;

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY;	


WITH DAT
AS (
	SELECT FULLDATE AS_OF_DATE
		,MONTH_END
	FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
	WHERE FULLDATE = CAST(@DateProcessed AS DATE)
	)
	,LE
AS (
	SELECT AS_OF_DATE
		,CASE 
			WHEN LEFT([VALUE], 1) = '_'
				THEN NULL
			WHEN CHARINDEX('_', [VALUE]) > 0
				THEN (
						CASE 
							WHEN TRIM(LEFT([VALUE], CHARINDEX('_', [VALUE]) - 1)) = ''
								THEN NULL
							ELSE TRIM(LEFT([VALUE], CHARINDEX('_', [VALUE]) - 1))
							END
						)
			ELSE (
					CASE 
						WHEN TRIM([VALUE]) = ''
							THEN NULL
						ELSE TRIM([VALUE])
						END
					)
			END CIF_ID
		,NULL PRIMARY_FLAG
		,FOR_EXCLUSION
		,ID LE_ID
		,CASE 
			WHEN [VALUE] = ''
				THEN NULL
			ELSE [VALUE]
			END LE_CIF_ID_ORIG
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_BIRTH_REGISTRATION_PLACE LE_ATTRIBUTE_BIRTH_REGISTRATION_PLACE
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_CBC_MM_TAXEXEMPT LE_ATTRIBUTE_CBC_MM_TAXEXEMPT
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_CBS_MM_TAXEMPT LE_ATTRIBUTE_CBS_MM_TAXEMPT
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_CBS_MM_TAXEXEMPT LE_ATTRIBUTE_CBS_MM_TAXEXEMPT
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_CBS_WMG LE_ATTRIBUTE_CBS_WMG
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_EXPIRY_DATE_OF_CSA LE_ATTRIBUTE_EXPIRY_DATE_OF_CSA
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_FINANCIAL_SOPHISTICATION_CLASSIFICATION LE_ATTRIBUTE_FINANCIAL_SOPHISTICATION_CLASSIFICATION
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_INDUSTRY LE_ATTRIBUTE_INDUSTRY
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_INDUSTRY_TYPE LE_ATTRIBUTE_INDUSTRY_TYPE
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_INDUSTRY_TYPE_2 LE_ATTRIBUTE_INDUSTRY_TYPE_2
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_LEGAL_ENTITY_TYPE LE_ATTRIBUTE_LEGAL_ENTITY_TYPE
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_MIDDLE_NAME LE_ATTRIBUTE_MIDDLE_NAME
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_MSG_PERSONNEL_WHO_APPROVED_CSA LE_ATTRIBUTE_MSG_PERSONNEL_WHO_APPROVED_CSA
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_NATIONALITY LE_ATTRIBUTE_NATIONALITY
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_OPTIONF_NATIONALID LE_ATTRIBUTE_OPTIONF_NATIONALID
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_RECOMMENDED_PRODUCTS LE_ATTRIBUTE_RECOMMENDED_PRODUCTS
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_RISK_TOLERANCE_CLASSIFICATION LE_ATTRIBUTE_RISK_TOLERANCE_CLASSIFICATION
		,LE.[ATTRIBUTE_SOPHISTICATED_(INDIVIDUAL)] [LE_ATTRIBUTE_SOPHISTICATED_(INDIVIDUAL)]
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_TIN LE_ATTRIBUTE_TIN
		,LE.ATTRIBUTE_UMID LE_ATTRIBUTE_UMID
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_1 LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_1
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_1_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_1_IND
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_IND
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_SATT LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_SATT
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_SATT_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT_SATT_IND
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCT_ODB LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCT_ODB
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCT_ODB_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCT_ODB_IND
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_2 LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_2
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_2_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_2_IND
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_FCY LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_FCY
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_FCY_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_FCY_IND
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_PHP LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_PHP
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_PHP_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_PHP_IND
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_RTGS LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_RTGS
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_RTGS_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_RTGS_IND
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_SWIFT LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_SWIFT
		,LE.CBCATTRIBUTE_SWIFT_IND LE_CBCATTRIBUTE_SWIFT_IND
		,LE.COMMENT LE_COMMENT
		,LE.COUNTRY LE_COUNTRY
		,LE.EXTERNAL_REF LE_EXTERNAL_REF
		,LE.FULL_NAME LE_FULL_NAME
		,LE.LEGAL_ENTITY LE_LEGAL_ENTITY
		,LE.PARENT LE_PARENT
		,LE.PARENT_SHORT_NAME LE_PARENT_SHORT_NAME
		,LE.ROLES LE_ROLES
		,LE.SHORT_NAME LE_SHORT_NAME
		,LE.STATUS LE_STATUS
		,LE.BNK_CODE
		,DAT.MONTH_END
	FROM DAT
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITY LE 
		ON DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN SCD_START_DATE
			AND SCD_END_DATE
		AND BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
	CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(EXTERNAL_REF, '|')                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
	)
	,PROD_GROUP
AS (
	SELECT *
		,CASE -- Based from Qualified Transaction Filters
			WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
				AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
					'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
					,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
					)
				AND (
					TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
					OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
					)
				AND (
					TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE IS NULL --ADDED BACK
					OR TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE NOT LIKE 'PYA%'
					)
				AND TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE NOT IN (
					'LTNCD'
					,'PN'
					)
				THEN 'Money Market Product'
			WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
				AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
					'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
					,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
					)
				AND (
					TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
					OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
					)
				AND (
					TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE IS NULL --ADDED Back
					OR TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE NOT LIKE 'PYA%'
					)
				AND TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'PN'
				AND DATEDIFF(YEAR, TRADE_SETTLE_DATE, MATURITY_DATE) = 0
				THEN 'Money Market Product'
			WHEN TRADES.product_type LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND TRADES.BOOK = 'Client'
				AND (
					TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
					OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
					)
				THEN 'Fixed Income Product'
			WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
				AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
					'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
					,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
					)
				AND (
					TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
					OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
					)
				AND (
					--TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE IS NULL
					TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE NOT LIKE 'PYA%'
					)
				AND TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'PN'
				AND DATEDIFF(YEAR, TRADE_SETTLE_DATE, MATURITY_DATE) > 0
				THEN 'Fixed Income Product'
			WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
				AND TRADES.BOOK IN (
					'F_Intl_MM_Team1'
					,'F_Intl_MM_Team2'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Team1'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Team2'
					,'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing'
					)
				AND (
					TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
					OR TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = ''
					)
				AND (
					--TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE IS NULL
					TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE NOT LIKE 'PYA%'
					)
				AND TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'LTNCD'
				THEN 'Fixed Income Product'
			WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
				AND (
					TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA'
					OR TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%'
					)
				THEN 'Structured Product'
			WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%'
				AND TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP'
				THEN 'Structured Product'
			WHEN TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
				AND TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE IN (
					'FX'--FXForward
					,'FXForward'
					,'FXNDF'
					,'FXSwap'
					)
				THEN 'FX Product'
			WHEN TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE IS NULL
				AND TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE IN (
					'Swap'
					,'SwapCrossCurrency'
					)
				THEN 'Derivative Product'
			END PRODUCT_GROUP
			,TRADES.NAME AS TR_SECURITY_NAME
			,TRADES.Coupon AS TR_COUPON
			,TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_AssetSwapYield AS TR_TRADE_KEYWORD_ASSETSWAPYIELD
			,TRADES.Yield AS TR_YIELD
			,TRADES.Book_Attr_Profitcenter AS TR_BOOK_ATTR_PROFITCENTER
			,TRADES.Coupon_Frequency AS TR_COUPON_FREQUENCY
			,TRADES.Currency_Pair AS TR_CURRENCY_PAIR
			,TRADES.Issued_Date	AS TR_ISSUED_DATE
			,TRADES.Issuer AS TR_ISSUER
			,TRADES.Pay_Leg_Settle_Currency AS TR_PAY_LEG_SETTLE_CURRENCY
			,TRADES.Pay_Leg_Type AS TR_PAY_LEG_TYPE
			,TRADES.Rcv_Leg_Type AS TR_RCV_LEG_TYPE
			,TRADES.Receive_Leg_Settle_Currency AS TR_RECEIVE_LEG_SETTLE_CURRENCY
			,TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_Terminationdate_Columns AS TR_TRADE_KEYWORD_TERMINATIONDATE_COLUMNS
			,TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_Terminationtradedate_Columns AS TR_TRADE_KEYWORD_TERMINATIONTRADEDATE_COLUMNS
			,TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_Trustaccount AS TR_TRADE_KEYWORD_TRUSTACCOUNT
			,TRADES.TRADE_KEYWORD_Trustrole AS TR_TRADE_KEYWORD_TRUSTROLE
	FROM DAT
	LEFT JOIN EDS.TRY_TRADES TRADES ON DAT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN TRADES.SCD_START_DATE
			AND TRADES.SCD_END_DATE
	WHERE TRADES.MATURITY_DATE >= DAT.AS_OF_DATE
		--AND TRADES.TRADE_SETTLE_DATE <= DAT.AS_OF_DATE 
		AND BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
	)
	,PROD_CODE
AS (
	SELECT *
		,CASE 
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product' or (PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Structured Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%'
				AND BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP')
				THEN TRADE_KEYWORD_ClientName_ID
			ELSE COUNTERPARTY_ID
			END LE_ID
		,CASE 
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Money Market Product'
				AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'DSA'
				THEN 'DSA'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Money Market Product'
				AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'TCD'
				THEN 'TCD'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Money Market Product'
				AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'Res - TCD'
				THEN 'RTCD'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Money Market Product'
				AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'PN'
				THEN 'PN'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'BONDMMDISCOUNT'
				AND [NAME] LIKE 'BSP BILL%'
				THEN 'BSPB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND (PRODUCT_TYPE = 'BONDMMDISCOUNT')
				AND (
					PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN LIKE 'PIBL%'
					OR PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN LIKE 'PH%'
					)
				THEN 'TB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND [NAME] LIKE 'RTB%'
				THEN 'RTB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'Bond'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN LIKE 'PPB%'
				THEN 'RTB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN LIKE 'PIBD%'
				THEN 'FXTN'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'Bond'
				AND [NAME] NOT LIKE 'RTB%'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN LIKE 'PH%'
				AND TRADE_CURRENCY = 'PHP'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BONDTYPE = 'NG'
				THEN 'FXTN'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND [NAME] LIKE 'RDB%'
				THEN 'RDB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND ([NAME] LIKE 'ROP%')
				THEN 'ROP'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND [NAME] LIKE 'ODB%'
				THEN 'ODB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND TRADE_CURRENCY <> 'PHP'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BONDTYPE = 'N_RESI_GOVT'
				THEN 'FDGB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND TRADE_CURRENCY = 'PHP'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BONDTYPE NOT IN (
					'NG'
					,'RESI_GOVT'
					,'N_RESI_GOVT'
					)
				THEN 'PCB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'Bond%'
				AND TRADE_CURRENCY = 'USD'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BONDTYPE NOT IN (
					'NG'
					,'RESI_GOVT'
					,'N_RESI_GOVT'
					)
				THEN 'DCB'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'LTNCD'
				THEN 'LTNCD'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE = 'PN'
				THEN 'LPN'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Structured Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows'
				AND (
					BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA'
					OR EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%'
					)
				THEN 'PYA'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Structured Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%'
				AND BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP'
				THEN 'AS'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'FX Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'FX'
				THEN 'FXSP'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'FX Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'FXForward'
				THEN 'FXF'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'FX Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'FXNDF'
				THEN 'FXNDF'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'FX Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'FXSwap'
				THEN 'FXSW'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Derivative Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'Swap'
				THEN 'IWS'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Derivative Product'
				AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'SwapCrossCurrency'
				THEN 'CCS'
					--ELSE 'REMOVE'
			END PRODUCT_CODE
	FROM PROD_GROUP
	WHERE NOT (PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product' AND TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TRADETYPE IN ('LTNCD','PN')) OR TRADE_SETTLE_DATE <= AS_OF_DATE --added 
	)
	, TMP_AS AS
	(
	SELECT 
	  LE_ID
	, PRODUCT_GROUP
	, PRODUCT_CODE
	,CASE 
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Money Market Product'
					THEN PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
					AND PRODUCT_CODE NOT IN (
						'LTNCD'
						,'LPN'
						)
					THEN TRADE_CURRENCY
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
					AND PRODUCT_CODE IN (
						'LTNCD'
						,'LPN'
						)
					THEN PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'FX Product'
					THEN PRIM_CUR
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Derivative Product'
					THEN PAY_LEG_PRINCIPAL_CCY
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Structured Product'
					AND PRODUCT_CODE = 'PYA'
					THEN PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Structured Product'
					AND PRODUCT_CODE = 'AS'
					THEN TRADE_CURRENCY
	END PRINCIPAL_VALUE_CCY
	, CASE 
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
					AND PRODUCT_CODE NOT IN (
						'LTNCD'
						,'LPN'
						)
					THEN PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP IN (
						'Money Market Product'
						,'FX Product'
						,'Derivative Product'
						--,'Structured Product' #Move to Bundle_id
						)
					OR (
						PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
						AND PRODUCT_CODE IN (
							'LTNCD'
							,'LPN'
							)
						)
					THEN CAST(TRADE_ID AS VARCHAR)
				WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP='Structured Product'
					THEN CAST(BUNDLE_ID AS VARCHAR)
				END ACCT_ID
	, TRADE_DATE
	, TRADESTATUS
	, AS_OF_DATE
	, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
	, NOMINAL
	, PRIM_AMT
	, PAY_LEG_OUTSTANDING_NOTIONAL
	FROM 
	PROD_CODE
	WHERE PRODUCT_CODE ='AS'

	 )
	, TM_AS_EXCLUDE_LIST AS
	(
	 SELECT 
		  LE_ID
		, PRODUCT_GROUP
		, PRODUCT_CODE
		, PRINCIPAL_VALUE_CCY
		, ACCT_ID
		, TRADE_DATE
		, TRADESTATUS
		, AS_OF_DATE
		, CASE WHEN NOMINAL > 0 THEN NOMINAL*-1 ELSE NOMINAL END AS PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG
		, COUNT(*) CNT
	FROM TMP_AS
	GROUP BY
		  LE_ID
		, PRODUCT_GROUP
		, PRODUCT_CODE
		, PRINCIPAL_VALUE_CCY
		, ACCT_ID
		, TRADE_DATE
		, TRADESTATUS
		, AS_OF_DATE
		, CASE WHEN NOMINAL > 0 THEN NOMINAL*-1 ELSE NOMINAL END
		HAVING COUNT(*)=2
	)	
	,NOT_AGG_FORMULA
AS (
	SELECT PROD_CODE.AS_OF_DATE
		,LE_ID
		,PRODUCT_GROUP
		,PRODUCT_CODE
		,TRADE_DATE
		,BOOK
		,SALES_PERSON
		,PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
		,PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN ISIN
		,CASE 
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE NOT IN (
					'LTNCD'
					,'LPN'
					)
				THEN PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP IN (
					'Money Market Product'
					,'FX Product'
					,'Derivative Product'
					--,'Structured Product' #Move to Bundle_id
					)
				OR (
					PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
					AND PRODUCT_CODE IN (
						'LTNCD'
						,'LPN'
						)
					)
				THEN CAST(TRADE_ID AS VARCHAR)
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP='Structured Product'
				THEN CAST(BUNDLE_ID AS VARCHAR)
			END ACCT_ID
		,MATURITY_DATE
		,TRADESTATUS
		,PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType TR_PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BONDTYPE
		,Product_Description TR_Product_Description
		,Product_Type TR_PRODUCT_TYPE
		,CASE 
			WHEN TRADESTATUS = 'CANCELED'
				THEN 'N'
			WHEN (
					PRODUCT_GROUP IN (
						'Money Market Product'
						,'Derivative Product'
						)
					OR (
						PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Structured Product'
						AND PRODUCT_CODE = 'PYA'
						)
					)
				AND (
					TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED'
					OR (
						TRADESTATUS = 'MATURED'
						AND CAST(MATURITY_DATE AS DATE) = PROD_CODE.AS_OF_DATE
						)
					OR (
						TRADESTATUS = 'TERMINATED'
						AND CAST(TRADE_KEYWORD_TerminationDate_Columns AS DATE) = PROD_CODE.AS_OF_DATE
						)
					)
				THEN 'Y'
			WHEN (
					PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
					OR (
						PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Structured Product'
						AND PRODUCT_CODE = 'AS'
						)
					)
				AND (
					TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED'
					OR (
						-- TRADESTATUS = 'MATURED'
						CAST(MATURITY_DATE AS DATE) = PROD_CODE.AS_OF_DATE
						)
					)
				THEN 'Y'
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'FX Product'
				AND TRADESTATUS IN (
					'VERIFIED'
					,'ROLLED'
					,'RATE_RESET'
					)
				THEN 'Y'
			ELSE 'N'
			END IS_QUALIFIED
		,CASE 
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Money Market Product'
				THEN PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE NOT IN (
					'LTNCD'
					,'LPN'
					)
				THEN TRADE_CURRENCY
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Fixed Income Product'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE IN (
					'LTNCD'
					,'LPN'
					)
				THEN PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'FX Product'
				THEN PRIM_CUR
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Derivative Product'
				THEN PAY_LEG_PRINCIPAL_CCY
			WHEN PRODUCT_GROUP = 'Structured Product'
				AND PRODUCT_CODE = 'PYA'
				THEN PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY

, TREASURY_MTD_YTD AS
(
		SELECT
		  TMP.FULLDATE
		, TMP.Previous_Business_Day
		, TMP.CIF_ID
		, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE
		, TMP.ACCT_ID
		, TMP.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_CCY
		, TMP.BANK_ID
		, Business_Day_Flag
		, CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG CB_OB
		, CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG CPB_PB
		, (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) END) AS PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG
		, (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) END) AS PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP
		, 
		(CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_PHP,0) ELSE		
		SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) END)
			OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) +  (CASE WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE)=YEAR(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN coalesce(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_PHP,0) ELSE 0 END) END)  AS TOTAL_PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP
			
		,coalesce(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_PHP,0) DF_ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_PHP
		,DF.AS_OF_DATE DF_AOD
		, 
		(CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_ORIG,0) ELSE		
		SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) END)
			OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) +  (CASE WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE)=YEAR(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN coalesce(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_ORIG,0) ELSE 0 END) END)  AS TOTAL_PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG
		, CAST(TMP.DAYOFYEAR AS SMALLINT) DAYOFYEAR
		, LastDayOfMonth
		, CAST(Day AS SMALLINT) Day
		, month_end_diff
	
	, (

					(
						(CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_ORIG,0) ELSE		
		SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) END)
			OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) +  (CASE WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE)=YEAR(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN coalesce(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_ORIG,0) ELSE 0 END) END)
						+ (case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff * coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) else 0 end)
					) / (TMP.DAYOFYEAR + case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
		) AS YTD_ADB_PRN_ORIG
		
		, (
					(
						(CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_PHP,0) ELSE		
		SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) END)
			OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) +  (CASE WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE)=YEAR(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN coalesce(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PRN_PHP,0) ELSE 0 END) END)
						+ (case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff * coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) else 0 end)
					) / (TMP.DAYOFYEAR + case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
		) AS YTD_ADB_PRN_PHP
		
		, (((CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(TMP.Previous_Business_Day) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_ORIG,0) ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) END)
		OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) + (CASE WHEN MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN coalesce(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_ORIG,0) ELSE 0 END)  END)
		+ (case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff * coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) else 0 end)  
		) 
		/ (DAY + case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff  else 0 end)
		) AS MTD_ADB_PRN_ORIG
		
		, (((CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(TMP.Previous_Business_Day) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_PHP,0) ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) END)
		OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) + (CASE WHEN MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN coalesce(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_PHP,0) ELSE 0 END) END)
		+ (case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff * coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) else 0 end)  
		)
		/ (DAY + case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
		) AS MTD_ADB_PRN_PHP	

		, ((CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(TMP.Previous_Business_Day) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_ORIG,0) ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) END)
		OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) + (CASE WHEN MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN coalesce(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_ORIG,0) ELSE 0 END) END) 
		+ (case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff * coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG,0) else 0 end)  
		) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG

		, ((CASE WHEN TMP.Previous_Business_Day=DATEADD(day,-1,TMP.FULLDATE) AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(TMP.Previous_Business_Day) THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) + coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_PHP,0) ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) ELSE coalesce(CURRENT_PBD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) END)
		OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) + (CASE WHEN MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE)=MONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN coalesce(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PRN_PHP,0) ELSE 0 END) END)
		+ (case when TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' then month_end_diff * coalesce(CURRENT_BD.PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP,0) else 0 end)  
		) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP	
		, TMP.MONTH_END
		        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE DESC) RN
		, MIN(LEAST(CURRENT_BD.EARLIEST_TRADE_DATE,CURRENT_PBD.EARLIEST_TRADE_DATE)) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE DESC) AS EARLIEST_TRADE_DATE
		, MAX(GREATEST(CURRENT_BD.LATEST_TRADE_DATE,CURRENT_PBD.LATEST_TRADE_DATE)) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.CIF_ID, TMP.LE_ID, TMP.PRODUCT_CODE, TMP.ACCT_ID, TMP.BANK_ID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE DESC) AS LATEST_TRADE_DATE
